description: End-to-end data governance and stewardship workflow for telecom NOC software configuration, telemetry, and policy data.

service_id.description: Unique identifier for a managed NOC software service (e.g., alarm manager, telemetry pipeline).

dataset_id.description: Identifier for a registered configuration, telemetry, or event dataset.

policy_id.description: Identifier for a data governance policy applicable to NOC software datasets.

schema_version_id.description: Identifier for a specific version of a data schema.

steward_id.description: Identifier of a data steward or owner (user, group, or role).

access_request_id.description: Identifier for a data access request ticket.

data_issue_id.description: Identifier for a logged data quality or compliance issue.

remediation_run_id.description: Identifier for an automated data remediation run.

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: discover_noc_datasets
functions.description: Scan registered NOC software services to discover new or changed datasets (config, logs, telemetry, alarms).

services.description: Optional list of NOC services to restrict discovery scope. If omitted, all known services are scanned.

filters.description: Criteria to limit which datasets are discovered.

update_window.description: Only consider datasets first seen or updated in the given time window.

min_record_count.description: Only include datasets with at least this many records.

include_unclassified_only.description: If true, only datasets without any classification are returned.

include_schema_sample.description: Whether to include inferred schema samples for each discovered dataset.

functions.returns: List of discovered datasets with provisional dataset_id, basic metadata, and optionally sampled schema.

functions.name: register_dataset_profile
functions.description: Register or update a dataset in the governance catalog with profiling metadata and lineage.

dataset_id.description: Existing dataset identifier if updating; omitted for new registrations.

versions.description: Known schema versions for this dataset.

functions.returns: Dataset ID (new or existing), schema_version_id, and updated catalog profile summary.

functions.name: classify_dataset_sensitivity
functions.description: Apply sensitivity and retention classifications to a dataset and its columns.

schema_version_id.description: Specific schema version to apply column-level classifications to. If omitted, uses current_version_id.

contains_cdr.description: Indicates whether Call Detail Records are included.

approver.description: Approval details for the classification change.

functions.returns: Updated dataset and column classification summary including effective policies.

functions.name: define_governance_policy
functions.description: Create or update a reusable data governance policy for NOC software datasets.

policy_id.description: Existing policy identifier if updating; omit to create new.

scope.description: Defines what this policy applies to.

tags.description: Policy is applied to datasets with matching tags (all must match).

rules.description: List of enforcement rules under this policy.

expression.description: Domain-specific expression (e.g., DSL or JSONPath) describing when rule applies.

action.description: Action to take when rule triggers.

items.description: Steward IDs responsible for this policy.

functions.returns: Policy ID, current status, and summary of effective scope and rule count.

functions.name: evaluate_policy_compliance
functions.description: Evaluate one or more datasets against applicable governance policies and compute compliance status.

policy_ids.description: Optional subset of policies to evaluate. If omitted, all active policies in scope are used.

include_details.description: If true, include per-rule evaluation details and matched records estimates.

evaluation_mode.description: Defines how deep the evaluation goes and cost/latency tradeoffs.

functions.returns: Per-dataset compliance summary with applicable policies, pass/fail status, and optional detailed rule evaluations.

functions.name: submit_data_access_request
functions.description: Create a data access request for NOC datasets, to be reviewed by data stewards.

requester.description: Identity of the user or system requesting access.

datasets.description: Target datasets and requested access level.

columns.description: Optional list of specific columns requested.

purpose.description: Business justification for access (e.g., outage RCA, capacity planning).

attached_policies.description: Optional list of policy IDs that the requester explicitly commits to.

auto_approve_if_low_risk.description: If true, system may auto-approve based on classification and policy rules.

functions.returns: Access request ID, initial status (pending/approved/rejected), and list of required approvers.

functions.name: review_access_request
functions.description: Approve, reject, or request changes for an existing data access request.

modifications.description: Optional modifications if decision is request_changes.

functions.returns: Updated access request status, effective permissions (if approved), and audit trail entry.

functions.name: log_data_quality_issue
functions.description: Log a data quality or compliance issue against a specific dataset or schema version.

reported_by.description: Steward ID or system name reporting the issue.

sample_records.description: Optional anonymized sample records illustrating the issue.

suspected_root_causes.description: Possible causes linked to NOC software or upstream sources.

linked_policies.description: Policies potentially violated by this issue.

functions.returns: Data issue ID, initial status (open), and routing information for steward triage.

functions.name: plan_data_remediation
functions.description: Create a remediation plan for one or more data issues, specifying automated and manual steps.

owner_steward_id.description: Primary steward responsible for this remediation plan.

max_impact_records.description: Guardrail for maximum records to change in a single run.

functions.returns: Remediation plan ID and summary of steps, linked issues, and approval status.

functions.name: execute_data_remediation
functions.description: Execute an automated data remediation plan and track progress.

steps_to_run.description: Optional specific step IDs to execute. If omitted, all eligible steps are run.

run_mode.description: Dry run only simulates changes and impact metrics.

checkpointing.description: Checkpoint configuration in case of failures.

functions.returns: Remediation run ID, initial status, and estimated impact (records to change, affected datasets).

functions.name: get_remediation_run_status
functions.description: Retrieve status, progress, and results for a remediation run.

include.description: Additional details to include in response.

functions.returns: Current run status (pending/running/completed/failed/cancelled), progress metrics, and optional detailed step information.

functions.name: rollback_remediation_changes
functions.description: Rollback changes made by a remediation run where supported by checkpoints or backups.

dry_run.description: If true, only estimate rollback impact.

functions.returns: Rollback job status, estimated or actual number of records reverted, and any irrecoverable changes.

functions.name: search_governed_assets
functions.description: Search across governed datasets, policies, and issues for discovery and reporting.

query.description: Free-text query against names, descriptions, and tags.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching assets (datasets, policies, issues, remediation plans) with summary metadata.

functions.name: get_dataset_governance_state
functions.description: Retrieve the full governance state for a dataset, including schema, classifications, policies, issues, and active access grants.

as_of_time.description: Optional time-travel to view state as of a specific time.

functions.returns: Composite view of dataset governance state across requested aspects, suitable for stewardship review.

functions.name: search_noc_governance_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across noc_governance entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching noc_governance entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_noc_governance_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N noc_governance records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_noc_governance_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many noc_governance records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_noc_governance_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many noc_governance records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_noc_governance_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of noc_governance data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_noc_governance_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a noc_governance dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_noc_governance_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more noc_governance entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_noc_governance_snapshot
functions.description: Restore noc_governance state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_noc_governance_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the noc_governance workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_noc_governance_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across noc_governance metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_noc_governance_audit_events
functions.description: Search the noc_governance audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_noc_governance_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers noc_governance workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_noc_governance_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for noc_governance events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_noc_governance_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for noc_governance events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_noc_governance_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off noc_governance job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_noc_governance_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled noc_governance jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_noc_governance_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled noc_governance job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_noc_governance_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a noc_governance operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_noc_governance_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a noc_governance action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_noc_governance_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a noc_governance approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_noc_governance_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any noc_governance entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_noc_governance_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a noc_governance entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_noc_governance_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling noc_governance behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_noc_governance_policies
functions.description: List noc_governance policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_noc_governance_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two noc_governance-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_noc_governance_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a noc_governance entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.
